question: What forehead-centered repetition is enjoined upon the god-worshipped practitioner?
premises: The instruction prescribes performing a hundred-thousand repetitions.
The repetition is situated in the mass of letters on the forehead.
The directive is addressed to one worshipped by the gods.
inference: The practitioner is enjoined to perform a hundred-thousandfold repetition focused in the forehead letter-mass.
uncertainties: The precise referent of varṇa-rāśi (letters, syllables, or colors) in this archaic Kaula context remains context-dependent.
plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred-thousand repetitions situated in the mass of letters on the forehead.
